title: Collapse repeated Audacity project extensions
problem: The Linux save dialog can append .aup4 to a suggested filename that already has it, while Audacity's cleanup removes only the final suffix and saves name.aup4.aup4.
reproduce: Return session.aup4.aup4 from the project save dialog; the baseline strips the final suffix and restores it, leaving the duplicate unchanged.
acceptance: Missing, foreign, single and repeated case-insensitive project extensions all produce exactly one lowercase .aup4, and the dialog uses one valid *.aup4 filter group.
repair: Centralize project-extension normalization, remove remaining duplicate aup4 suffixes, use a valid single-group project filter, and add focused project tests.

selection.reason: The fresh Linux report has deterministic filename acceptance, no competing PR, and all pinned submodule revisions were verified.

verification.limitations: BCL compiles and executes the production path helper with six cases and verifies upstream test registration. It does not build or launch the complete Qt application; upstream CI remains required.
verification.ownerCheck: On Linux, create a new project, accept or edit the suggested name, save it, and confirm the resulting filename contains exactly one .aup4 extension.
